name: Amelia - Enthusiastic and Expressive
description: A young British English woman's voice, clear and easy to understand. Expressive and enthusiastic, it's beautiful for narration, podcasts and social media such as YouTube, Tiktok, Reels and Stories. This studio-produced audio is great for a young woman's Gen-Z voice in audiobooks, high-quality video dubbing, advertising and reading.
